facts.fact: iAfrikan reports the BCEAO told every bank, e-money issuer and payment institution in the eight WAEMU countries, Togo included, in April 2026 to be connected to PI-SPI by 30 June 2026, then on 25 June 2026 moved the deadline to 30 September 2026 (microfinance institutions to 30 June 2027).
